query: WITH scope_tracks(track_id) AS ( SELECT entity_id FROM user_library WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'track' UNION SELECT entity_id FROM user_feedback WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'track' AND value = 'like' UNION SELECT pt.track_id FROM playlist_tracks pt JOIN playlists p ON p.id = pt.playlist_id WHERE p.owner_user_id = ? AND p.is_temporary = 0 UNION SELECT mf.track_id FROM media_files mf JOIN library_folders lf ON lf.id = mf.folder_id WHERE mf.storage = 'folder' AND lf.owner_user_id = ? UNION SELECT t.id FROM tracks t WHERE t.album_id IN ( SELECT entity_id FROM user_library WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'album' UNION SELECT entity_id FROM user_feedback WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'album' AND value = 'like') ) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scope_tracks WHERE track_id = ?)
